comparison.objective: Clear a towel from a rice-cooker steam vent and start the cooker.
comparison.physical_skill: Remove an obstruction, place it safely, and actuate a sprung button.
comparison.success_condition: Vent clear, COOK activated, towel supported, button released, and grippers withdrawn for 1 second; covering the vent while running permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Obstruction removal and button actuation do not test separation of mixed rigid bodies through a screen.
